name: Kaidou Shizuku
source:
A shy girl of few words.
Because of her mother's interest in a new cult, this luckless girl had to face many hardships.
She seems to hate boys, apart maybe from Sekiguchi who is seated next to her.

[From in-game charater profile]

A member of class 503.
